b: Massive Attack, Kraftwerk and Cher are among the big names heading to the Somerset farm next summer
Glastonbury has revealed the first wave of acts playing its 2027 edition.

The festival will be headlined by Billie Eilish, Harry Styles and Sam Fender, while Cher will take the Sunday afternoon 'Legends slot' at the main Pyramid stage. Also high up on the bill are Massive Attack, Kraftwerk, The xx, Little Simz and Ezra Collective.

The first lineup announcement is rounded out by the likes of FKA twigs, Robyn, Primal Scream, Underworld, De La Soul, The Avalanches, Dinosaur Jr., underscores, Hot Chip, Mike D, Young Fathers and Thundercat.
